note: An empty waivers array is a meaningful assertion, and it is meaningful here because there is nothing this corpus compares loosely. Every surface is PRODUCED by the grapt-service controller model from the action rows and compared byte-for-byte against the committed files: no normalisation, no tolerance, no excluded field and no re-blessing during a run. Nothing is compared against the frozen TypeScript engine either, so no intentional non-parity can arise from a cross-engine difference. One asymmetry is named rather than waived, because it is a scope fact and not a comparison exclusion: the frozen product keeps its owner identity in a registration file whose contract is `(url, pid, version, password)`, and this corpus deliberately does NOT reproduce that shape. Master corrects owner identity to {ServiceSlotId, ServiceInstanceId, EnvironmentReceipt} with PID and URL as attributes, and The registration identity contract requires that PID, URL and version never become R4D-1 identity. Recording the frozen shape would therefore have been reproducing the defect. How a retained engine maps into this scheme is a later explicit receipt, and the registration header `secode-service/registration/1` is the versioned seam it arrives through.
